resolved_findings.title: Password obfuscation service not enabled
resolved_findings.recommendation: Review credential exposure. This command is weak obfuscation, not strong encryption.

resolved_findings.title: AAA new-model not detected
resolved_findings.recommendation: Assess centralized AAA (for example TACACS+ or RADIUS) for managed environments; local-only designs may be intentional.

resolved_findings.title: Login failure throttling not detected
resolved_findings.evidence: No login block-for command was found.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Where supported, configure login failure blocking based on operational policy.

resolved_findings.title: Log timestamps not explicitly configured
resolved_findings.evidence: No service timestamps log datetime command was found.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Enable useful timestamps for event correlation where supported.
resolved_findings.remediation_example: service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone

resolved_findings.title: Remote syslog destination not detected
resolved_findings.evidence: No logging host/IP command was found.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Consider sending logs to a protected central syslog/SIEM service; verify reachability and access controls.

resolved_findings.title: Login or MOTD banner not detected
resolved_findings.evidence: No login, motd, or exec banner was found.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Use an organization-approved access warning banner where policy or law requires it.

resolved_findings.title: Source-routing protection not explicit
resolved_findings.evidence: no ip source-route was not found.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Confirm the platform default and explicitly disable source routing if supported by policy.

resolved_findings.title: NTP server not detected
resolved_findings.evidence: No ntp server command was found.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Configure approved time sources so logs can be correlated across devices.

unchanged_findings.title: No IPv4 ACL definitions detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: No numbered or named IPv4 ACL definition was found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: If filtering is part of the design, verify ACLs are defined and applied in the correct direction; absence may be intentional.
unchanged_findings.remediation_example: ! Define ACLs only from the approved network policy

unchanged_findings.title: Routed interface has no interface ACL detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: FastEthernet0/0.20 has an IP address but no ip access-group command was detected in the interface block.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Check the intended trust boundary and firewall/routing policy; an interface ACL is not required on every interface.

unchanged_findings.title: Enable secret not found
unchanged_findings.evidence: No enable secret command was found in global configuration.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Configure an approved strong enable secret if privileged EXEC access uses local credentials.

unchanged_findings.title: No local username using secret syntax detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: No local username ... secret command was found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Verify the AAA design; configure protected local credentials if local authentication is required.

unchanged_findings.title: SSH version 2 not explicitly configured
unchanged_findings.evidence: ip ssh version 2 was not found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: If supported, explicitly require SSH version 2 and validate client compatibility.

unchanged_findings.title: VTY transport policy not explicit
unchanged_findings.evidence: No transport input command found in line vty 0 4.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Review platform defaults and explicitly restrict management transports.

unchanged_findings.title: VTY idle timeout not detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: No exec-timeout command found in line vty 0 4.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Set an idle timeout appropriate to the security policy.

limitations: Comparison is based on rule_id and target/interface when present.
A lower heuristic risk score does not prove the network is secure.
Validate the configuration and connectivity in an isolated lab after changes.
